name: Cueva
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: Constenla Umaña, Adolfo & Enrique Margery Peña. 1991. Elementos de fonología comparada Chocó. Revista de Filología y Lingüística de la Universidad de Costa Rica 17(1-2): 137-191. DOI 10.15517/rfl.v17i1-2.20972 (online 2015).
sources.note: Cueva appears only in the introduction (sec. 0.2, pp. 138-139): four or five chronicle words (yra 'mujer', cabra 'lugarteniente', chica 'comer', tuyra 'diablo') compared with Waunana/Emberá after Loewen 1963a:245 to argue a Chocoan affiliation. Sec. 2.3 'Acento' (pp. 151-152) concerns Proto-Emberá and modern Emberá varieties (free accent reconstructed; penultimate in Saija/Chamí), not Cueva. Nothing on Cueva stress.

sources.citation: Baquero M., Alvaro. 1987. [Review of] Kathleen Romoli, Los de la lengua de Cueva: los grupos indígenas del istmo oriental en la época de la conquista española (Bogotá: ICAN/Colcultura, 1987). Boletín Museo del Oro 19: 141-142.
sources.note: Review only; reports that Romoli's book (222 pp) contains 'seis tablas con vocablos Cueva, un cuadro fonológico, un mapa, un glosario'. No statement on stress.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1 languoid cuev1238 (https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/cuev1238); Wikipedia EN 'Cueva language' and ES 'Idioma cueva'; Wikidata Q5192644.
sources.note: Glottolog lists no descriptive references. Wikipedia: c. 50 words recorded by Oviedo in the early 16th c.; extinct c. 1535; bibliography names Loewen 1963, Loukotka 1968, Constenla & Margery 1991, Romoli 1987, Quesada Pacheco 2024. Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Quesada Pacheco, Miguel Ángel & Koenraad De Smedt. 2024. Distancia lingüística entre la lengua cueva y la familia chocó. Aproximación estadística. In Quesada Pacheco (ed.), La lengua cueva (Panamá, siglo XVI), 133-146. München: LINCOM.

sources.note: The only structural description of Cueva; reconstructs phonology from the chroniclers' spellings and is the one place a (philological) statement on Cueva accent could appear. Chapter registered in NVA/Cristin (hdl.handle.net/11250/4451479) but without an attached file.

sources.citation: Romoli, Kathleen. 1987. Los de la lengua de Cueva: los grupos indígenas del istmo oriental en la época de la conquista española. Bogotá: Instituto Colombiano de Antropología / Instituto Colombiano de Cultura. 222 pp.

sources.note: Ethnohistory with six tables of Cueva words, a 'cuadro fonológico' and a glossary (per Baquero 1987 review); the main pre-2024 collection of the attested forms.

sources.citation: Loewen, Jacob A. 1963. Chocó I: Introduction and bibliography. International Journal of American Linguistics 29(3): 239-263 (p. 245 on Cueva).
